Advanced privacy — optional analytics

These optional reports are separate from automatic Connected Clients counting.

${row('feature-visitors','Optional visit estimates','Help us count visitors anonymously. Disabled in Private mode.','Optional, off by default and paused in private mode. Only a random first-party identifier and consent are sent, without cookies, URLs, searches or page content. A signed receipt stays on this browser to avoid recounting; server-side identifier hashes and last visit times expire after 30 days. Aggregate lifetime totals remain. Turning this off stops future reports. Clearing site data may count this browser again. These are estimated browsers, not people.')} ${row('feature-activity','Optional activity analytics','Optional reports only. Records stay in memory and expire after 30 minutes idle; active means within 5 minutes. Compatible browsers use Web Locks to prevent duplicate enrollment.')} ${row('feature-arcade-analytics','Optional Arcade launch totals','Count game openings without saving your identity.
